steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: If you want to come with me, you do exactly as I say throughout the whole thing.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Do you understand?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Yes! Hehe...

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: What are you laughing at?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: It's just, you're so dependable, Lyudmila.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Don't say things you can't take back.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: When did you two become such good friends? I guess I never should've worried that you wouldn't get along.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: She's different. We met each other in the Rhodes Island canteen.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Oh, is that why? At the canteen—

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Ah! So you're the red-haired lady who makes great Ursine and Siracusan food!

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Back on topic. My Arts can conceal my movements. I'll go and find Zima first; it won't be hard if Rosa's coordinates are accurate.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Rosa reports that the situation in the quarantine zone is in flux. It's possible that Zima's base of operations may have moved. Go ahead and check it out, but come back if things don't work out.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Mm-hm.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Why can't we go together?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Pavlovich's people control the mobility layer passages since the lockdown. We'll alert them if we go on together. You have to wait here.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: This area is outside Katorga Raion, and all the workers know me. If anyone comes over, just tell them you're with Lyudmila Ilyinichna.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Understood, but it's best not to be detected. We'll stay hidden and wait for your signal.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: When you see Zima, see if she's hurt, if she's gotten thinner—

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: I'll do my best.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: No patrols? That's different from the reports.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Sonya's camp should be just ahead.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: ...If you don't want me to talk to Matvey, I won't. You want to be by yourself, I won't bother you.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: But holler if you need someone to talk to, okay?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I'm here for you. Don't put everything on your own shoulders.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: What the...?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Rosalind—
Don't yell. It's me.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: You told me to find you if I ever needed help, didn't you?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: So I came.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: The comms equipment looks good.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: So you've dealt with the thugs from within the wall, and you're preparing to leave.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: No wonder I didn't see a soul on my way here.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: The thugs on the ground might be done for, but the ones on the walls are still up there. We have a tough fight ahead of us.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Are you ready for it?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: We have to think we are. I don't have time or energy to ask every one of them what they think, but the fact that they haven't stopped training is enough.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: I'm not questioning any of you. Based on what I know from the outside, it's a miracle that you're alive at all, much less united and fighting.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: What are they saying out there?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: That it's His Majesty Pavlovich's little kingdom, and he alone decides what lives and what dies within.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: The nobles don't care anymore. After all, this plate is going be discarded like cutting away a piece of rotten flesh, along with everyone on it.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: That's how Ursus is, how it always has been... yet those who are abandoned end up struggling to survive.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Amiya didn't want us to have too much contact with you. I never knew you were so sentimental.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: It's not about sentimentality...

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Let me put it another way. On my way here, I saw someone huddled by a campfire crying, being comforted by someone who was smiling. Their arms were bandaged, and they were as dirty as the snow on the ground.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Some were chatting, some were holding steaming cups of water, some were roasting things over the fire.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: They've been through so many things in a place like this, yet they didn't look like they're in pain. Really, they looked like they were looking forward to tomorrow.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: They had nothing but the hope in their hearts. I've seen this scene before, the same expressions on faces before, in...

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Thanks for sharing.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: But we're really short on supplies. Every day might be our last. This cup of tea here could be too. If you don't want it, I do.
Crownslayer says nothing, but gestures for her counterpart to go ahead.
The plainly exhausted young woman does not demur. She lifts the steel cup and downs its contents, tea that has been brewed so many times it hardly has any color left.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: ...I've told you all the important parts. Anything you want to know before you leave?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Is there anything I can help with before I go?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Well... maybe it's a dumb question.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: But do you think maybe you could use your Arts to get these students out the way you came in?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: The mobility layer passage is very narrow. We could maybe get a few dozen out in a night, but you have hundreds... Besides, There is only one way to the passage.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: They are bound to notice your move of this size. If the students get caught out in the open, even with my Arts, we won't stand a chance once those thugs start raining fire down on us—

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Forget I said anything. Should've known it wasn't so simple.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Other than that, is there anything I can do?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I thought you were going to ask me if I wanted to escape with you.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Didn't bother. You're not leaving.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Damn straight.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Actually, there IS something you can do. You said you came in through the mobility layer. I take it you're familiar with what's down there...
Talk about bad luck?
I guess you're in here by accident. You don't look like the kind of man who would associate with the elements here.

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: Ah... yes, you're right. This was quite an absurd accident.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: What are you doing?

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: Just memorializing fallen friends.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: I'm sorry. You look sad. I hope I'm not interrupting you.

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: Oh, it's perfectly alright. I'm used to being interrupted.

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: Be my guest, sit down by the fire and get some warmth. There are roasted potatoes, if you're hungry... what's your name?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: My name is Lyudmila... but my friends call me Crownslayer.

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: ...That's a cool nickname.

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: Have you... slain any particularly important crowns?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Sadly, not yet. But I've seen many tyrants, or should I say, leaders.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: The first was in Ursus. She was a remarkable woman, one of the most remarkable I've ever met. She was powerful, and a charismatic leader.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: But her ideals were too distant, and her methods too idealistic. That's why she failed. Maybe it's not quite fair to call her a tyrant. She was just one of the many who fell by the wayside.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: The second was in Siracusa. She wasn't even a leader when I first met her. She was a good person, and an unlucky one.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: She became a leader after a strange twist of fate, and tasted power before she realized the importance of responsibility. I was worried she would go astray, but we're destined to go our separate ways.

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: You've seen a lot. I envy you. I've never even left Grypherburg.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: As for the third, I've only ever heard his name and deeds.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: I've never seen him with my own eyes—until now.

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: Who sent you? You don't look like one of Witte's.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Don't bother guessing. I'm not after you.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: What an experience it is, to come back to Ursus after all this while, only to experience something as crazy as this. I guess the State Council's freaking out right about now, trying to get you out without causing a scene.

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: Perhaps. Or perhaps someone wants me to die in here quietly.

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: I don't know. I don't think it really makes a difference whether I'm here or in the palace.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: The commoners hate you, the nobility looks down on you. How do you even manage that?

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: When you try to change something, the people whose cake gets moved do all they can to oppose you. People take turns opposing all the different decisions you make.

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: Never mind... you wouldn't understand.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: I wouldn't. You sound like you think you're doing your best to govern your country. How did Ursus end up like this, then?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: You said you've never left Grypherburg? You should. Go out there, and see what this empire of yours really looks like under your rule.

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: That's enough!!!

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: I don't need your ridicule... don't think I don't know what's wrong with the empire. I want to change it too.

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: You don't know how hard I've tried. No one does. But what can I do, if no one ever truly supports me?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: So what? Are you saying it's everybody else's fault, and you're just a sweet, innocent little tsar?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: You want your suffering people to empathize with how hard things are for you, when you don't even understand your own responsibility?

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: Fine. You're right, I'm a terrible tsar. What are you waiting for, then?

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: Kill me already. Fulfill the wishes of the nobles who want me dead, and make the commoners who hate me happy.

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: Then you'll no longer be a little girl who gave herself a stupid khuyovy nickname, but a true crownslayer at last.

spans.text: Then you'll no longer be a little girl who gave herself a stupid
nickname, but a true crownslayer at last.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Snap out of it, svolotsch!

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Killing you would be easy, but what would that achieve? You think Fyodor matters? Not even a little bit, I tell you.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Every kid in Ursus has heard the story of how the tsar put down the Great Rebellion at the age of ten. Do you think they know what kind of mudak sits on the throne?

spans.text: Every kid in Ursus has heard the story of how the tsar put down the Great Rebellion at the age of ten. Do you think they know what kind of

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Do you think your deeds bring glory to the name Fyodor? You don't understand your own responsibility, yet you're complaining as though everything under the sun is doing you an injustice.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: You're simply a kid who never grew up, living a lie that all the people around you keep spinning for you.

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: Yebat—

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Are you really mourning the people you saw die? Tragedies like these and much worse happen every day in Ursus. Do you really mourn them?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: If you really want to save people, go back to where you should be, find a few decrees that do the right thing, and put your signature and stamp on them.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Is it so hard? The question is, do you really want to do it? Do you know what the right thing is?

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: I regret inviting you to my campfire.

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: I don't like to be vulgar, but there are always people who want to make me angry.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Thank you for the invitation, Your Imperial Majesty.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: I pray your generosity will reach further.

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: Where are you going?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: None of your business.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Don't worry, you want to keep indulging in your little game here, that's your choice. I won't tell anyone.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: There's just one thing I'll say...

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: If you were really trying so hard to bring about change, then the palace wouldn't be the only place that's still lit at night, while the rest of Ursus put together doesn't have enough candles to illuminate Grypherburg.
As Crownslayer departs, a gust of wind extinguishes what is left of the campfire before Fyodor.
Darkness falls, leaving the silent tsar and the wanderer in the cold night.

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: I know you're there. Show yourself.

steps.name: 'Emperor's Blade'
steps.text: Your Imperial Majesty.

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: ...Why am I not surprised that you followed me here?

steps.name: 'Emperor's Blade'
steps.text: Your will and that of Chairman Witte was to avoid any further disturbances arising from your disappearance.

steps.name: 'Emperor's Blade'
steps.text: We therefore had to remain hidden.

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: And? What's Witte planning to do with Katorga?

steps.name: 'Emperor's Blade'
steps.text: That is not for us to know.

steps.name: 'Emperor's Blade'
steps.text: If you wish to speak to him, you should return to the palace with us immediately.

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: You want to bring me back, quietly put me in a car, then put me back on that chair.

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: I'm telling you, no.

steps.name: 'Emperor's Blade'
steps.text: You should understand your own situation.

steps.name: 'Emperor's Blade'
steps.text: You are too young, and too willful, compared to the old tsar.

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: Idi na hui! Do not compare me with a man who's been dead for ages! Get out of my sight!

spans.text: Do not compare me with a man who's been dead for ages! Get out of my sight!

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: I'm not leaving. I have things to do. I am not a mannequin for Ursus to display in the shop window.

steps.name: Fyodor
steps.text: Tell Witte that if he wants me to leave here, he can come pick me up himself.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: They're gone...

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Over here!

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: You ran into workers on patrol?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: If 'workers' are people dressed like policemen and carrying machetes and sticks, then yes.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: You ran into Pavlovich's people? But this isn't Katorga, they shouldn't—

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: It was a few guys in worker garb that helped us hide. But they left in a hurry, and I didn't get any information from them.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: What about Zima? Did you see her? Is she and Leto alright?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Zima, Leto and the students they gathered are planning to leave the quarantine zone, maybe in the next couple of days.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Leave? Did that Pavlovich let them go?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Not the kind of leaving where you just open the door and walk out.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: What are they planning? Can we help?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: I asked the same question. Anyway, I'll talk to the workers on duty in the mobility layer tonight.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: First, I need to try the comms equipment that Zima gave me, or those unemployed workers will soon lose electricity and heat.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Where do we try?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: I don't have a safehouse in this area. We need to find somewhere more remote.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: This will do.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: The gear's heavy. I'll hold it; you take the headset.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: What about me? Is there anything I can do?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Keep watch. Tell us if there's any movement.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Alright!

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: First try.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Can you hear me?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Hello?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: (Whisper) I think I got through, but there's no sound on the other side.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Hello? Can you hear me?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: No sound. I don't think it's the signal.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Not a particularly unusual occurrence. We may have to try again later.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: How long do we have to wait? Can we...

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Can we go and find Zima first? Or maybe those workers you were talking about?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I just feel like we should do something. I want to help, if we can help.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Can we reach them from somewhere else?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: There's a comms blackout in Katorga. This equipment will probably be useless in there.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: It's dangerous to go into a direct confrontation unprepared, even if it's a localized conflict within the quarantine zone.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Rosa's report mentioned that some nobles provided military supplies to Pavlovich. Zima's group may be facing military-grade firepower.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I'm not afraid.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Gummy?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I'm not afraid! I want to stand with Zima and Leto—at least stop some bad guys, or crossbow bolts from the shadows!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I want to help them.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Even if it means you'll hurt other people?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: ...If I have to...

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: You hesitated. You're not a soldier, Gummy, and neither are Zima or the rest of her comrades. I would rather you not have to face conflicts like this, if that's an option.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Everyone has their own battlefields. No one's is more or less important than any other's.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: What if I told you that a lot of lives depend on what I'm doing right now, Gummy? How would you choose?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Crownslayer, there's no need to—

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: If we leave and try to get into the quarantine zone, and fail to get electricity to the people of Grypherburg in time—

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Countless people will freeze to death in places like Odoyev, within a week.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: If you stay here without helping Zima and Leto, they might get hit by a bolt, by a shell fragment... they might be in danger, one way or another.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: How would you choose?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: There's no need to be so cruel, Crownslayer!

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Cruel? You think this is cruel?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Do you think you're doing a favor to her by hiding from her what she needs to know? Do you think you're taking responsibility by taking away her choice?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Isn't that arrogance really cruel to those who are left behind?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Hey...

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Which would you choose, Gummy?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I—

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: —Why not all of them?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Uh—

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I'll help you now, once you are done here, I'm off to help Zima!

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Fine.

steps.name: Communicator
steps.text: Barge...

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Wait, I hear a voice.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Huh?
The weak, faint voice from the headset grows clearer.
It is a gentle, hesitant male voice, one that Crownslayer has never heard before.

steps.name: Communicator
steps.text: ...Snow Maiden, Great Fin...

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: I've never heard this voice before. He's not my contact.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: He doesn't even seem to be forming a coherent sentence.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: What is he saying?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Sounds like a bunch of unconnected words. It's weird.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: 'White Night.'

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: 'Ice Queen.'

a.text: White Night, Ice Queen, Dreamer, Land, Monster, Chervontsy, Barge, Snow Maiden, Great Fin.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: I know all the words, but what does it mean when they're put together?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Hello? Can you hear me? Can you give me any clearer clues?

steps.name: Communicator
steps.text: Clue...

steps.name: Communicator
steps.text: Who?

steps.name: Communicator
steps.text: Who is this? Who am I talking to?
The voice on the other side suddenly grows louder, and broken noises seep from the headset.
Gummy looks down at the words that Crownslayer wrote, and feels her heart race.
White Night, Ice Queen, Dreamer, Land, Monster, Chervontsy, Barge, Snow Maiden, Great Fin.
She has seen these words before. She screams soundlessly, clutching the corners of her shirt tightly, staring at the scribbled words as though trying to bore a hole in the paper.
Those hands holding a book, those hands stroking her hair, that hand wearing that familiar watch... the scenes flash before her eyes.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Lyudmila—
She casts her burning gaze toward the bewildered Crownslayer.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Hello? This is supposed to be my communications channel. How did you find it?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Who are you—

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Lyudmila!

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Huh? What is it?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I want to listen.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: This is all he said. There is nothing else.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I want to listen. Please.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Did you figure something out?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I'll know if I listen.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: ...Go ahead.
Crownslayer removes the headset and gives it to the girl.
Gummy takes it with trembling hands, putting it over her ears carefully.

steps.name: Communicator
steps.text: ...Chervontsy, Barge, Snow Maiden, Great Fin.

steps.name: Communicator
steps.text: Do you remember that? You remember it?

steps.name: Communicator
steps.text: Remember it all! Remember!

steps.name: Communicator
steps.text: I'll say it again. White Night, Ice Queen, Dreamer, Land...
The voice seems so strange, yet so familiar.
A voice that has become distorted through transmission and loss.
A voice that Lada will never forget.

steps.name: Gentle Voice
steps.text: 'How much land does a person need?'

steps.name: Young Girl
steps.text: I hear Papa's voice on the earphone!

steps.name: Gentle Voice
steps.text: 'Fifty hectares? One thousand? Fourteen thousand?'

steps.name: Gentle Voice
steps.text: 'No, none of those.'

steps.name: Young Girl
steps.text: How many is it, then?

steps.name: Gentle Voice
steps.text: Have patience, my dear Lada.

steps.name: Gentle Voice
steps.text: 'Ivan walked a long, long way, and returned to where he began before the sun rose. He used up all his strength, and he cannot get up anymore.'

steps.name: Young Girl
steps.text: Someone will help him, right? Right?

steps.name: Gentle Voice
steps.text: Of course, little cub. Of course.

steps.name: Gentle Voice
steps.text: 'The people, in awe of his perseverance, helped him up, and gave him clean water and soft bread.'

steps.name: Gentle Voice
steps.text: 'When he woke up, he saw the path that he walked during the day, and the marks he left.'

steps.name: Gentle Voice
steps.text: 'It was a wide, broad land, totalling...'

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: 'The land that Ivan needed his entire life was two meters long, one-and-a-half meters wide, one-and-a-half meters deep.'

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Papa...

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: You lied to me.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I opened the book again when I grew up. It said, this is all the land that a person needs their entire life.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: It's the size of a coffin, isn't it?

steps.name: Communicator
steps.text: Who are you? What are you talking about?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: It's Lada, Papa!

steps.name: Communicator
steps.text: Lada...

steps.name: Communicator
steps.text: Lada?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: It's me! It's me! Where are you? What are you trying to tell us?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Tell me, let me hear your voice again...

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: If it's the same channel, and it's your father that we reached this time, then the one before...

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Do your parents work for the same institution?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I don't know. I think so...

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: We'll get to the bottom of this, someday.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Did he say anything before hanging up? Other than these ten terms?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: It was twelve bits.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: There are two more?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Yes. The other two are 'Sarcophagus' and 'Satellite City'.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: The first ten terms each correspond to a children's book with the words in its title.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: All books that my dad used to read to me.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Somehow, I don't think your father just wants us to find these children's books.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: He explained.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: He said the first ten terms correspond to the first two digits of the ten books' identifier numbers. For the last two terms, we take the first character.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Digits and letters, twenty-two in total, the standard format of Ursine military installation identification codes. As for where it is—

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: The answer is obvious.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Sarcophagus, Satellite City.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Dur-nar, Gummy, if you're in a hurry, we can set out for the quarantine zone right now.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Mm... I was thinking about what you said to me.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I don't want to make the others worry, but I want to help. I'll find students I know in the quarantine zone, and do some things in secret.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Good. Crownslayer—

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: I'll come back and contact the workers who are still fighting underground once I've taken you there.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: I'm sure they would love to meet our honorable magistrate.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: *Cough*—*cough*—

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Zima?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: ...Instructor?!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: What are you doing here? What about the rest of the SSG? Are they alright?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Of course. It's you we're worried about.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: What's with this smoke?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Pavlovich's men attacked the camp. Set it on fire and left. Said it was revenge for what we did.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Funny, isn't it? I've seen fire after fire here, and they've extinguished the one that burned in my mind all this time, the Chernobog fire.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Zima, if Chernobog makes you—

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: No, instructor, thank you...

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Grappling with whether to face my fears when my friends are in danger... that's not like me. I'm used to getting my body to move first.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Besides, I have more than just my fists.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: You mean—

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: 'Unity.'

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I used to think about nothing but leading the charge. But now... now that I know those guys are behind me, I know that we're all headed towards the same goal... I'm confident we can do anything.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: What are you planning to do?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: If he's resorting to burning stuff, that means Pavlovich has lost his heavy weapons.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: They think they're spreading fear. In fact, they're exposing their own weakness... it's an opportunity.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: We'll settle the score with Pavlovich, morning of the day after tomorrow.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I need your help, instructor.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Sure, but I thought Leto was with you? I don't see her anywhere.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: After the attack, I sent her to warn our allies, and talk about coordinating our attack.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: That is, if he still thinks we're allies...
I saw Matvey, standing alone before the burning house.
It was a lot smaller than I remembered, against the backdrop of towering factories. Even the fire was dwarfed by the burning workshops.
He looked up at the smoke above the fire that wouldn't go away, the broken beams, and the scattered pages. His face was as calm and impassive as it had always been.
But it was his house, which he built plank by plank, nail by nail... it was the headquarters of the Unbound. It was our home.

steps.name: Ukusik
steps.text: Who? Who did this?!

steps.name: Ukusik
steps.text: Matvey... they—

steps.name: Ukusik
steps.text: Blyat! Mudak!

steps.name: Matvey
steps.text: Ah, Ukusik.
There was no other expression on his impassive face. Or maybe my tears just blurred my vision.
Matvey sighed and knelt down to wipe my tears. There was blood all over half his face, but I couldn't see a wound.

steps.name: Matvey
steps.text: 'Don't cry over spilt cystymilk.' Remember?

steps.name: Ukusik
steps.text: But cystymilk's expensive! I've only ever drank it once during New Year's!

steps.name: Matvey
steps.text: It won't stay expensive forever.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Antosha, if there's anything you need...

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: No. We have some reserves, and we've shared the loot with you.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: We can't stay on the defensive, staying in camp like this... Sonya wants me to tell you that we're planning to attack at dawn, the day after tomorrow.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Our target is the wall.

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: Tell Sonya, there's no way the Unbound won't show up to strike Pavlovich.

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: We will hit his command headquarters. We have been planning this for a long time.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I'll have to talk it over with Sonya.

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: You can talk all you want. I don't answer to her. That's my decision.

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: But you can trust me on this...

steps.name: Antosha
steps.text: We will not disappoint those who fight by our side.

steps.name: Vasily
steps.text: The Imperial Guard's direct command battalion has been deployed to the outskirts of the quarantine zone. Do we set out now to welcome His Imperial Majesty back?

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: No. Wait a while longer.

steps.name: Vasily
steps.text: But the Royal Guard reports that the situation in the quarantine zone will only get more chaotic—

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: All the more reason for us to use this opportunity to fully expose the plans of certain onlookers. Before His Imperial Majesty's precise whereabouts are announced, before we bring him back to the palace safe and sound...

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: Both the traitors who attempt to harm His Majesty after learning the truth, and the opportunists who choose to parley with the rebels because of the tsar's disappearance, will be stepping up their plans.

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: We must catch them all.

steps.name: Vasily
steps.text: What if some of them come to their senses?

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: Then let us hope we will see their anxious or excited familiar faces in the procession welcoming His Imperial Majesty's return.

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: He has given them plenty of opportunities with those days of bargaining and probing.

steps.name: Vasily
steps.text: It seems the malaise of Ursus runs deep.

steps.name: Witte
steps.text: Yes, Vasha, it does. We must hope that we are not too late to cut its tumors.
